title: chore(ts-migration): adds api extrator for public definitions files and strip Internals
body: This pull request **now** uses api extractor for validating the public files we are exporting instead of a single file. Here is an example: In addition, it adds **stripInternals** option the tsconfig file, so we can hide some internals from the public API.

comments.body: Did you think the warnings from api-extractor weren't useful after all?

@Haroenv They are useful - but the goal of having API Extrator is detect missing exported types on a a **single file public api**. With the current approach, and to move faster, we are going to have around 120 files.
@Haroenv Maybe in the future, and with more time, once we have root level exports and can have again api extrator 👍
Will this configuration be enough to catch error types like when `InstantSearchOptions` is not exported? If not, how important do you think it is?
